neighbours.label: praise of a person's standing or excellence (world renowned, prestigious, exceptional), on the praise word
fire: Meet Lena, a world famous pastry chef from Vienna.

She won an extremely prestigious prize for her early novels.
An outstanding violinist, Mira toured Europe at nineteen.

The firm hired a brilliant young lawyer to handle the appeal.
quiet: Meet Lena, a part-time pastry chef from Vienna.
He is a young architect who designs glass towers.
The festival invited a Chicago-based jazz pianist this year.

A retired violinist, Mira taught music in her village.
